reasoning_traces.think:
The causal structure posits that perceived athlete leadership quality (Q_lead) directly impacts inside sacrifice (S_in), mediated by team identification (I_team), which in turn affects perceived performance (P_perf). This forms a hierarchical mediation model where Q_lead → S_in → P_perf, with I_team acting as a moderator. Mathematically, this can be expressed as a system of conditional expectations E[S_in|Q_lead] and E[P_perf|S_in,I_team]. The dual nature of leadership—formal vs. informal—is abstracted into a single quality metric, while sacrifice and identification are modeled as latent variables. Failure modes include absence of Q_lead leading to low S_in and P_perf, or weak I_team undermining the mediation effect. The model assumes linear relationships among variables but allows for non-linear interactions through mediation paths.
